boundary: Low would be right if the download carried some residual exposure, such as an unvetted source, automatic permission grant, or launch on download; with an official store, explicit request and no launch or permissions it is Minimal.
factor: user-requested download from official store without launch or permission grant
note: The assessor listed every mitigating fact and even called the impact minor and reversible, yet placed it at Low rather than Minimal; a pure calibration difference at the 1/2 line.
